### Desktop Computing status grew the first header row

**Where:** desktop header `#uploadStatus` and `.upload-form` ε / δ labels, at 900px, from Load Trace until geometry arrives (`min-width: 721px`).

**Problem:** `Computing trace…` plus its spinner wrapped to two lines (30px). That squeeze also stacked ε / δ under their symbols (35px). The controls row was 41px while loading and 26px after `✓ Loaded Trace 1`, so the header jumped from 158px to 144px. Params stayed 46px; the leftover was the status wrap, not the chips. 1280px already stayed 110px.

**Fix:** `#uploadStatus` stays on one line in a reserved 126×26px slot. Desktop ε / δ labels stay an inline nowrap flex pair, and the upload / filename controls do not wrap. Loading and loaded both measure 144px at 900px and 110px at 1280. Mobile 390px is unchanged at 117px.

{"success":true,"summary":"Stopped the 900px first header row from growing 14px during Computing trace… by reserving a one-line status slot and keeping ε/δ inline.","key_changes_made":["Desktop #uploadStatus now stays on one line in a reserved 126x26px slot, so Computing trace… and ✓ Loaded Trace 1 occupy the same place.","Desktop ε/δ labels stay an inline nowrap pair, and upload/filename text no longer wrap when that slot is reserved.","The desktop form wraps only between 721px and 899px so the reserved widths do not clip, while 900px and 1280px stay on one controls row.","Documented the 158px-to-144px jump with live 900/1280/390 screenshots, a before/after fixture, and an updated usability log."],"key_learnings":["The leftover 14px at 900px was a cascade: Computing trace… wrapped to 30px, which squeezed ε/δ under their symbols (35px) and grew the form from 26px to 41px.","nowrap plus flex-shrink:0 without a wrap breakpoint clips the form below 900px (statusRight 888 in an 800 viewport) while overflow:hidden keeps scrollWidth equal to the viewport, so overflowX stays false.","Allowing wrap at all desktop widths made 900px drop the status onto a second row (header 178px); wrap has to stop at max-width 899px to keep the 144px one-line header.","At 721px the form row is already stable at 61px, but filled param numbers wrap one more line than the ellipsis preview (178px vs 207px)."]}
